description: This file contains functions and logic for detecting and configuring mac80211 wireless devices, including PHY lookup, device checking, and wireless interface setup using UCI commands.

methods.name: lookup_phy
methods.description: Looks up the physical interface associated with a given wireless device based on device path or MAC address.

methods.name: find_mac80211_phy
methods.description: Finds and sets the PHY for a given wireless device.

methods.name: check_mac80211_device
methods.description: Checks if a device has a PHY assigned and finds it if not.

methods.name: detect_mac80211
methods.description: Detects available mac80211 wireless devices, configures them, and sets up wireless interfaces.
